schema: Periodic source-accessibility snapshot (every source, api/bridge verified through tools/fetch_source.py). Each result carries `status`, `fetch_method`, `class`, and a derived `action` (none | needs-bridge | needs-demote). The Ops dashboard floats only non-`none` actions — sources that need a dedicated bridge or demotion.
